title: oldenlandia linifolia

It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia linifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
